_comment: Local overlay for the controller DB. Entries here win over the vendored gamecontrollerdb.txt. Use 'by_vidpid' (key 'vvvv:pppp' lowercase hex) for USB pads, or 'by_guid' for an exact SDL GUID. 'mapping' is the SDL token:binding list (same syntax as gamecontrollerdb.txt, without the leading guid,name fields).
